sections.label: Male
sections.text:
Painful erections; sw^elling of the prepuce.
Thick, yellowish, muco-purulent discharge. Deep pain
in perinuem.

sections.label: Urine
sections.text:
Frequent,* burning, smarting, swelling, and
redness of meatus. Stream small and slow. Acute
aching in kidney region. Sensation of a ball pressing
against the urethra; worse, standing. Gleet, with pro-
fuse, thick discharge; chronic cystitis.
